I grow cassava and yam on this land. We do not use chemical fertilizer for root crops here in the South South because the soil is good and fertilizer is too costly. I will plant local cuttings from last season's harvest, not those hybrid seeds from the market. My family will do most of the clearing, planting, and weeding, but I will hire a few young people for about two weeks when it is time to harvest the yam.
